components.name: Today gradient loader
components.status: Selected loader; supplied motion with Today gradient. Browser and standalone SwiftUI, not integrated into the app.

browserIntegration.usage: Mount while work is pending, then remove on completion. The transparent 4.84-second loop uses a blue/lavender/peach gradient. Methods: play(), pause(), replay(); speed attribute/property from 0.1–4 (default 1), paused attribute, label attribute. Offscreen/hidden work is suspended; reduced motion shows a still globe. Host owns actual progress and completion; never claim percentage progress from the loop.

nativeIntegration.usage: TodayLoader().frame(width: 240, height: 240). isAnimating, speed, replayToken, colors and lineWidth are configurable. Includes TodayLoaderArtwork for a deterministic still. Original source is reference only; no packages/assets required.

components.name: Gradient profile avatar
components.status: Selected reusable browser and SwiftUI pieces. Maximum four including you; no native app integration.

browserIntegration.usage: Assign .person for a single profile, .members for stack/lead; stable id, name, initials, photoURL, optional gradientIndex and self. JSON person/members attributes also accepted. size 24–96, default36. lead-id optional. Photo falls back to deterministic varied gradient. FNV-1a over UTF-8 id; same palettes/algorithm as SwiftUI. Stack/lead render max4; host enforces membership. Wrap decorative piece in a labelled 44-point button when interactive. Lead stays inside compact/widget margins.

nativeIntegration.usage: TodayPartyAvatars.swift exposes TodayPartyMember, TodayProfileAvatar, TodayAvatarStack, TodayLeadAvatar and TodayAvatarPalette. Stable IDs required; never hashValue or array-position colors. See PARTY-AVATARS.md.
